```{r echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)

# Read data and clean the variable names
ces_measure <- read_csv("https://github.com/PHW290/phw251_projectdata/raw/refs/heads/main/scenario_3/calenviroscreen_measures_2021.csv") %>% clean_names()
ces_scores_demog <- read_csv("https://github.com/PHW290/phw251_projectdata/raw/refs/heads/main/scenario_3/calenviroscreen_scores_demog_2021.csv") %>% clean_names()
chhs_asthma <- read_csv("https://github.com/PHW290/phw251_projectdata/raw/refs/heads/main/scenario_3/chhs_asthma_ed.csv") %>% clean_names()
```

**1. For Cal Enviro Screen datasets**

1.1 Recode common variable(s) to be combined with other datasets
```{r}
# change county to title format
ces_measure_clean <- ces_measure %>% 
  rename(county = california_county)

ces_scores_demog_clean <- ces_scores_demog %>% 
  mutate(county = str_remove(county, " County"))

table(ces_scores_demog$county)
table(ces_scores_demog_clean$county)
```
